messages:
olivia (sec): Heads-up — noticed a gap in audit logs for admin role changes between 03/18 02:10-02:25 UTC. CloudTrail shows entries but our audit-stream didn’t ingest 6 events. filing INC-4123.
harper (infra): ack. do we know if KMS ops were involved? suspect a svcacct missing kms.decrypt on log-bucket key.
sec-bot: automated alert — audit-ingest-lag detected for stream=cloudtrail-prod, window=15m, drop=6 events. trace_id=ab12cd.
marcus (devops): pulling pipeline logs now. gcs->pubsub->cloud-run had a restart during that window, might be backpressure.
olivia (sec): pinging owners: @harper @marcus can you confirm if any manual admin role grants happened that match the missing timestamps? if yes, we need to reconstruct from CloudTrail and notify affected teams.
harper (infra): i checked IAM grants — there were two role.bind calls from svcacct:infra-runner@proj. looks like the runner retried. i’ll export the raw records.
alex (sre): if we reconstruct from CloudTrail we should also rehydrate the audit-stream sink to BigQuery for continuity. small checklist: 1) identify events, 2) re-ingest to bq, 3) alert owners, 4) update runbook.
jana (compliance): please cc compliance with the reconstructed evidence. we need a signed approval note for the quarterly audit.
marcus (devops): dumping CloudTrail slice now: `gsutil cp gs://cloudtrail-archive/2026/03/18/02/* /tmp/ct-slice/` then filter:```jq '.Records[] | select(.eventTime >= "2026-03-18T02:10:00Z" and .eventTime <= "2026-03-18T02:25:00Z")' /tmp/ct-slice/*.json > /tmp/ct-window.json```
marcus (devops): quick helper to get role bindings that changed:```gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json > iam.json
jq '.bindings[] | select(.role | test("roles/(owner|editor|securityAdmin|kmsAdmin)"))' iam.json > role-changes.json
```
olivia (sec): good. two follow-ups: can we confirm if the pipeline outage was due to kms permission error? harper?
harper (infra): found this in cloud-run logs: `ERROR: failed to decrypt object: permissionDenied for resource projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/logs/cryptoKeys/audit-key` at 02:12:08. service account infra-runner lacked kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter role in that region.
marcus (devops): granted a temporary binding to infra-runner@ for 15m at 02:13 per runbook to let replay proceed. that explains the role.bind calls — they were self-heal attempts by the pipeline controller.
jana (compliance): temporary grants must be documented in INC-4123. can you add who approved the temporary grant and paste the justification?
olivia (sec): action items: 1) @marcus rehydrate BQ with the 6 events and link to INC-4123, 2) @harper audit KMS bindings across regions and implement a least-priv template for the pipeline svcacct, 3) @alex update runbook with a circuit-breaker to stop auto-grant if repeated retries >3, 4) @jana confirm compliance record. please reply with ETA.
marcus (devops): ETA EOD today for rehydrate + link to ticket.
harper (infra): will run org-wide KMS binding scan and propose least-priv policy by tomorrow morning. snippet i’ll use:```gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy audit-key --location=global --keyring=logs --format=json | jq '.'```
alex (sre): i’ll draft runbook change and add the circuit-breaker pseudocode. ETA tomorrow noon.
jana (compliance): will add entry to audit binder and confirm with legal by EOD.
olivia (sec): 👍 once reingest is done please ping this thread and attach the BigQuery row ids. also please add a blameless note in INC-4123 describing why auto-grant was allowed and the mitigation plan.
marcus (devops): reingest complete — pushed 6 events to bq.table.audit_events, rows: [bqrow:2026_0318_021212, bqrow:2026_0318_021215, ...] link to INC-4123 updated.
olivia (sec): confirmed. closing loop: will schedule a small access-review pulse next week to sweep pipeline svcaccts and owners. thanks all. :thumbsup:
